packets.title: Make qualification comparisons semantic and diagnostics content-free
packets.scope: Correct only order-sensitive equality and top-level CLI diagnostic forwarding in qualification. Preserve proof, genesis, identity, custody, sampling, credit, and process-binding contracts.
acceptance: Compare artifact identity and rail policy by canonical value or explicit fields. Reordering object keys alone passes; changing any value fails. Genesis and artifact-proof validation remain unchanged.
The CLI maps JSON, filesystem and SQLite failures to fixed content-free diagnostics. A neutral input/path sentinel never appears on stderr; exit status remains 1 and stdout remains empty on failure.
Add focused reorder, changed-value and diagnostic-redaction cases to scripts/qualification.test.ts. Do not duplicate existing projection/privacy cases.
Run: bun test scripts/qualification.test.ts.

packets.title: Require a proof receipt before retaining native CI artifacts
packets.scope: Bind Linux and macOS retained native packages to a present proof receipt and make the workflow validator enforce the complete upload contract. This is workflow integrity, not native or release qualification.
acceptance: Both workflows explicitly verify the expected receipt file before artifact retention and retain no package-only artifact when proof or receipt production fails.
The validator pins Linux and macOS proof command, receipt check, upload action SHA, condition, artifact name, package path, receipt path, retention-days and if-no-files-found.
Mutation tests independently remove or change each receipt/retention binding on both platforms and require validation failure. Existing event-head and macOS checks remain.
Run: bun test scripts/verify-workflows.test.ts.

packets.title: Use the core sensitivity lattice for connector event hints
packets.scope: Remove the connector package's divergent lattice calculation by adapting its existing helper signature to the exported core resolver. Keep callers and importer output unchanged.
acceptance: Connector resolution delegates to the core max(floor, default, upward event hint) contract; it does not maintain a second order table or comparison algorithm.
A valid event hint can only raise the connector default. Unknown or absent policy/input remains private. Existing importer fixture labels remain unchanged.
Use small neutral lattice values only. Cover all public/personal/private default, floor and hint combinations plus absent/unknown inputs, asserting parity with core.
Run: bun test packages/connectors/test/sensitivity.test.ts.

packets.title: Advertise the source-policy field in every MCP output schema
packets.scope: Make the shared advertised MCP envelope schema match the optional source_policy object already emitted by core. Do not change core emission, tool registration, authorization or protocol transport.
acceptance: ENVELOPE_SHAPE contains optional source_policy with exact mode=enforced, positive integer epoch and legacy_unbound=owner_only fields.
After tools/list builds client validators, an ordinary epoch>0 response succeeds and structured/text content both contain the exact policy object. Epoch 0 omission remains valid.
A focused schema assertion rejects missing, extra, mistyped or invalid policy members without weakening any existing envelope field.
Run: bun test packages/mcp/test/schema.test.ts.

packets.title: Make bounded audit pagination explicit and complete
packets.scope: Expose bounded audit limit/offset pagination through the existing core offset seam and make incomplete output explicit in JSON and table modes. Do not modify core or documentation/help files.
acceptance: Audit accepts bounded --limit and --offset values, requests one extra row to determine truncation, returns at most the requested limit, and preserves newest-first stable ordering and all filters.
JSON data retains receipts and adds explicit truncated and next_offset fields; next_offset is null when complete. Table mode emits a clear continuation notice only when truncated.
Tests use a small ordinary receipt set and a low public --limit to cover first page, next page, final page, invalid bounds and filtered ordering. Do not create a 5001-row or resource-pressure test.
Run: bun test packages/cli/test/audit-undo.test.ts.
